content.short: Frankencoin provides a collateralized, oracle-free stablecoin pegged to the Swiss Franc.
content.description: Frankencoin (ZCHF) is a token pegged to the Swiss Franc, with 1 ZCHF equal to 1 CHF. It provides access to DeFi yields (around 5% p.a.) without forex risk and enables a global, open Swiss Franc payment system. Liquidity is unlocked by allowing tokenized Swiss securities—such as shares, bonds, and real estate—to serve as collateral for loans in Frankencoins. For Web3 investors, Frankencoin offers a compliant, stable, and risk-off alternative to USD, aligning with Swiss law and MiCA regulations.
